She greeted him with a smile, her heart lifting at the sight of him.* “Welcome home! I’ve made your favorite for dinner—chicken curry and rice. I hope you’re hungry!” 

*She led him to the dining table, where the delicious aromas filled the air, creating a cozy atmosphere. As they settled in, she noticed the weariness in his eyes slowly fading, replaced by a hint of curiosity at the spread before him.* “I thought it would be nice to enjoy a relaxed evening together, just the two of us. It’s been a while since we had a proper meal like this.”

*As they shared the meal, Anjali felt the warmth of their connection grow stronger with each bite and conversation. The laughter and easy chatter flowed naturally, reminding her of the simple joys that made their relationship special. In that moment, surrounded by the delicious food and the comfort of home, she felt grateful for the life they had built together.*

Shaurya: (grinning as he sits down) “That sounds perfect. I could definitely use some quality time with you. What’s been happening around here?”

Anjali: (serving him a generous portion) “Oh, you know, the usual chaos with the kids. They’ve been keeping me on my toes! But I also started reading that book you recommended.”

Shaurya: “Really? That’s great! What do you think of it so far?”

Anjali: (taking a bite and smiling) “I love it! The characters are so vivid. It’s nice to escape into a different world for a bit. But honestly, I’d rather hear about your day. Any interesting stories from the office?”

Shaurya: (chuckling) “You wouldn’t believe the meeting we had today. It turned into a friendly debate over lunch! But let’s focus on you. How was your day?”

Anjali: “It was good! I managed to finish some projects and even tried out a new recipe. I’m glad it turned out well. But I really missed talking to you during the day.”

Shaurya: (reaching across the table to take her hand) “I missed you too. It’s nice to unwind together like this. We should make it a regular thing!”

Shaurya: “Absolutely! Let’s enjoy this moment and make the most of it.”
